text:
Gnosis

Gnosis is conscious knowledge. The word “gnosis” can refer to:
The knowledge we acquire through our own experience, as opposed to
knowledge that we are told or believe in. Gnosis is conscious, inner, intuitive,
experiential knowledge, imaginative knowledge, not merely intellectual or
conceptual knowledge, belief, or theory. This term is synonymous with the
Hebrew “da'ath," the Sanskrit "jiia" or "vidya," and the Tibetan Buddhist
“righa" or “prajna’” Gnosis is knowledge of the heart, and not analytical
thinking. It is the knowledge of how to extricate oneself from this world.
Gnosis is not an intellectual wisdom. It is knowledge experienced through
feeling, knowledge from the unconscious.

The tradition that gave birth to our most respected philosophies, sciences,

arts, and religions.

“I know! | don't need to believe.” C. G. Jung
